column1: # FOSS / donor-first decision for capability BPT-SIMDSORT (x86_64 SIMD sort and partition intrinsics for Arrays.sort). GPLv2 with Classpath Exception, the same terms as the M3jdk21 base. Searched 2026-11-10: upstream openjdk/jdk, openjdk/jdk21u-dev, and the 13 pinned forks in make/m3/backports/COMMUNITY_FORKS.tsv.

column8: JDK 22/23 source of truth: 8309130 AVX512, 8317763 follow-up, 8319577 AVX2, 8321688 GCC 7.5 build fix, 8351233 ASAN fix. Upstream HotSpot is JDK 22+, so it is not directly applicable to 21.
The only JDK 21 backport found. Its 12 libsimdsort files are byte-equal to openjdk/jdk master, so every upstream fix is included. The HotSpot side is adapted to 21 and also covers 8317976 (Zen 4).
